properties.content:

Nearest City: Memphis, TN
Location: AIRCRAFT RAMP CARGO FACILITY 2903 SPRANKLE DRIVE
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: RADIOACTIVE/ 1.2 GBQ IN-111
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.064571, -89.966151 (Approximated from street_address)
Report Description
RADIOACTIVE MATERIAL TYPE A PACKAGE CONTAINING 1.2 GBQ IN-111 WAS RAN OVER. CAPS WERE OFF ALL SIX INTERNAL SHIELDED PIGS. THE VIAL CONTAINING RADIOACTIVE MATERIAL REMAINED IN FOUR PIGS. THE VIAL FROM THE FIFTH PIG WAS RECOVERED AND RETURNED TO THE PIG. THE SIXTH VIAL WAS CRUSHED RELEASING 197 MBQ ON THE ASPHALT TARMAC. THE CONTAMINATION WAS CONTROLLED, AND THE INITIAL CONTAMINATED AREA WAS REDUCED TO APPROXIMATELY A 4 CM DIAMETER AREA. THE CONTAMINATED AREA WAS SEALED WITH A STEEL PLATE WHICH WILL REMAIN FOR APPROXIMATELY 30 DAYS (10 HALF LIVES). AT THE END OF THE 30 DAY PERIOD THE CONTAMINATION WILL BE REASSESSED. THE RADIATION LEVEL AT THREE FEET ABOVE THE PLATE IS 0.5 MREM/HR, AND THE AREA IS NOT AN OCCUPIED AREA. THERE WAS NO PERSONNEL CONTAMINATION AND NO EXCESSIVE RADIATION EXPOSURE. NOR ASSISTANCE OR RESPONSE REQUIRED. PACKAGE CONTENTS AND CONTAMINATED MATERIALS WILL BE SALVAGED DRUMMED AND RETURN TO SENDER.

FH TRAIN DISPATCHER WAS NOTIFIED AND CHECKED WITH THE CREW. THERE WERE NO INJURIES TO THE CREW. THEY INDICATED THAT THERE MIGHT BE COAL IN THE CREEK. Skytruth Analysis
CALLER IS REPORTING THAT THERE ARE UNDERGROUND PIPELINES THAT WERE TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE FOR TRANSFERRING OF OIL, BUT WERE USED TO PROTECT NEW GAS LINES. CALLER STATED THE A1, A2, A3 AND A4 LINES WERE THE LINES THAT WERE USED TO TRANSFER OIL AND IT IS UNDETERMINED WHICH LINE OR LINES ARE LEAKING, THEREFORE, ANY ONE, OR ANY COMBINATION OF THOSE LINES ARE LEAKING. CALLER STATED THEY HAVE CONTACTED THE COMPANY TO REPORT THE LEAKING LINES, BUT WHEN THE COMPANY RESPONDED, THEY SAID THAT THE LINES WERE NOT LEAKING ANY GAS AND LEFT. THE LEAKING LINES WERE DISCOVERED ONE YEAR AGO AND CONTINUE TO DISCHARGE MATERIAL, MATERIAL DOES LEAK INTO A NEARBY WETLAND, AND A NEARBY RIVER AND CREATES A SHEEN ON THE WATER THAT BREAKS UP WHEN DISTURBED.
